description: BUILD-vs-REUSE decision matrix: upstream ZaoFu (Apache-2.0, v0.0.5, main@b5e569dd) vs P2P at c35-provider-neutral-runtime @ 7c9cb58. Decisions are REUSE / ADAPT / BUILD / DEFER / REJECT. Percentages are research-grade estimates supported by pointer evidence in evidence/zaofu-audit-areaNN.md.

matrix.capability: Deterministic orchestrator kernel (pure state machines, replayable actions)
matrix.p2p_implementation: RoleExecutionContract determinism; RoleExecutionReceipt state machine; C33 bounded-retry observer; C18 adaptive policy
matrix.adapter_cost: high — deep integration with ZfEvent/kernel semantics
matrix.authority_collision_risk: high — a second orchestrator would violate p2p-is-sole-orchestrator
matrix.expected_value: low (P2P's role-level determinism already serves the C35 lane)

matrix.capability: Rich task contract (behavior + verification tiers + provenance + execution profile + quality-gate overrides)
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/core/task/schema.py TaskContract (lines 27-153); execution_profile_id; verification_tiers {static,runtime,e2e,manual_evidence}; claim ids; per-task gate overrides
matrix.p2p_implementation: C33/C34 CONTRACT_SCHEMA dict (schema/allowed_scope/verify_spec/forbidden_actions); C35 RoleExecutionContract 22 fields
matrix.adapter_cost: medium — borrow the shape, not the dataclass
matrix.authority_collision_risk: medium — contract shape affects C33/C34 surfaces

matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/core/task/authority.py authority_revision_for SHA256({task_id,sequence,contract,execution_binding}); kanban.json projection; phase derived from events via derive_phase()
matrix.p2p_implementation: identity_hash SHA256 canonical JSON; quorum-of-receipts authority; goal-closure CONSISTENT gate
matrix.adapter_cost: low-medium — pure hash logic, no I/O
matrix.authority_collision_risk: medium — P2P's trust model is quorum-based, not CAS-based; must stay complementary

matrix.capability: Append-only event log with event sourcing and rebuildable SQLite read-model projections
matrix.zaofu_implementation: events.jsonl + EventIndex + BoundedIdSet dedupe; read_model.sqlite artifact/web projections; EventProjectors; 'never replace the append-only log as business truth'
matrix.p2p_implementation: Receipt/event append; governance JSON projections; candidate manifests; no event-sourcing read model
matrix.authority_collision_risk: low — projections never replace P2P governance truth

matrix.capability: Provider abstraction via declarative capability matrix + session readers
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/runtime/backend.py BackendAdapter + BackendCapabilities dataclass; ClaudeCodeAdapter; CodexAdapter; BackendSessionReader (UsageReport)
matrix.p2p_implementation: C34 BackendAdapterIdentity + BackendExecutionBridge; BackendCapabilityCertification LIVE_CERTIFIED_FOR_CAPABILITY; C30 ExecutionTarget composition
matrix.authority_collision_risk: low — P2P's certification authority stays P2P-owned
matrix.expected_value: high for C37 adaptive target selection

matrix.capability: Codex/Claude CLI session management (spawn, tmux panes, hooks, resume)
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/runtime/codex_hooks.py (5 hook events, trust hash v0.144); codex_session_ownership; ClaudeCodeAdapter flags
matrix.p2p_implementation: C27/C31 live probes against Codex CLI 0.147.0; C28 credential onboarding; native spawning via C34 bridge
matrix.authority_collision_risk: medium — ZaoFu spawns with --dangerously-bypass-approvals flags; conflicts with permission-envelope-never-widens
matrix.expected_value: medium (ZaoFu solves raw execution well) but vendor lock-in to its lifecycle

matrix.capability: Verification gates, judge evaluation, AND-closure discriminators, completion honesty
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/core/verification/gates.py (CommandGate/FileExistsGate); Evidence; JudgeEvaluator (grade A-D); discriminator AND-closure; completion_honesty.py; GoalClosureResult schema
matrix.p2p_implementation: role_verifier.py fail-closed failure classes; evidence pointers; deterministic quorum gate
matrix.authority_collision_risk: high if adopted wholesale — LLM-judge grading conflicts with P2P's deterministic verification standard
matrix.expected_value: medium-high — the read-only Thin-Judge-at-closure-boundary pattern is directly reusable

matrix.capability: Bounded retry / rework cap / recovery series / quarantine
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/runtime/canonical_recovery.py RecoverySeries; rework_dispatch_count; build_rework_cap_payload; valid_series_failures (replay/stale filtering); attempt_handoff_reducer; quarantine_candidate_from_plan; candidate_rework evidence extraction from real stdout/stderr
matrix.p2p_implementation: C33 bounded-retry observer; no cap-aware quarantine; no evidence-based rework messages; no recovering lifecycle state
matrix.expected_value: high — P2P currently lacks this entire mechanism

matrix.capability: Context delivery envelope, context manifest, briefing hydration, read receipts
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/runtime/context_delivery.py (immutable source manifest; required/delta_allowed sections; delivery envelope bound to workflow/task/contract/session/permission identity; delivery receipts without claimed reads); task_context_manifest.py (4-facet manifest; missing_required_refs; read_receipt_gaps)
matrix.p2p_implementation: C19 task-targeted context DONE; C36 planned; no delivery envelope or read-receipt accounting
matrix.authority_collision_risk: low — enriches C36, does not replace P2P context authority

matrix.capability: Adaptive execution control-plane actions (operator-visible verbs, YAML-declared handlers)
matrix.p2p_implementation: C18 adaptive orchestration policy foundation; C37 planned
matrix.authority_collision_risk: low — actions remain under P2P Owner Gates

matrix.capability: Budget enforcement and cost tracking (token USD, budget_exhausted halt)
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/core/cost/{tracker,billing,catalog}.py; check_budget → halt; brief_metrics soft budgets; automation_metrics autonomy/reliability/governance-drift signals
matrix.p2p_implementation: Usage evidence in receipts (C34); C36 cost intelligence planned; no enforced budget

matrix.capability: Multi-agent channel discussion state machine and autoresearch self-repair supervisor
matrix.zaofu_implementation: channel_router.py mention gates; channel_discussion.py idle→phase1_blind→phase2_relay→phase3_synthesis→idle with quorum/deadlines; src/zf/autoresearch/ (31 files: orchestrator, triggers, failure_signals 67KB, review gates)
matrix.p2p_implementation: C17 bounded parallel execution; role fanout; no deliberation state machine; no autoresearch loop
matrix.authority_collision_risk: medium — an autonomous repair loop conflicts with P2P's no-autonomy-before-owner-approval posture
matrix.expected_value: low-medium for the current roadmap (out of lane)

matrix.p2p_implementation: No skill system; canonical role instruction briefings
matrix.authority_collision_risk: high — skills materialized outside P2P's controlled briefing paths

matrix.capability: Security attestation and path safety (SHA-256 attestation of frozen dispatch artifacts; disjoint-path guards)
matrix.zaofu_implementation: src/zf/core/security/attestation.py (6 frozen classes; kernel-owned); hash.py; nonce.py; signing.py; safety/path_guard.py (assert_disjoint, owner marker)
matrix.p2p_implementation: C10/C14 owner approval; C28 onboarding; permission-envelope invariant; identity_hash attestation of governance artifacts
matrix.authority_collision_risk: low — P2P already hashes governance artifacts; ZaoFu extends to dispatch artifacts

matrix.capability: Observability dashboard and CLI (FastAPI kanban/cost/workers views; 40+ CLI subcommands; doctor/self_repair)
matrix.p2p_implementation: Beginner routing; evals; certification machinery; no live dashboard
matrix.expected_value: low for the beginner-first target audience (P2P deliberately routes to chat)

matrix.capability: ZaoFu as a whole-system dependency / vendor / fork
matrix.authority_collision_risk: prohibitive — violates p2p-is-sole-orchestrator and creates an authority split
matrix.expected_value: negative (v0.0.5, ~2 weeks old, Codex-deep, no stable release policy)

summary.interpretation: No capability should be wholesale REUSED (ZaoFu is too young and its integration layer is Codex-deep) and nothing needs to be newly BUILT because of ZaoFu. The correct posture is SELECTIVE ADAPT for concepts (contract shape, CAS revisioning, capability matrix, Thin-Judge pattern, bounded recovery, context delivery, control actions) while P2P retains full authority over governance, verification determinism, and the beginner-first layer. Raw execution harness work is left to upstream — P2P never planned to build it.
